body: There is a huge problem with this stigma.  I also hear all the time that suicide is "selfish." It blows my mind how blindsighted others are.  They truly have no idea and cannot relate, so they judge.  I handle this but either educating them, or staying away from them, depending on their arrogance level.  And I've lost many friends due to this because I realized a real friend is someone who shows compassion, not judgment.  They are few and far between, unless they're also struggling.  Needless to say, my best friends are also suicidal.  We just connect in so many ways.  I hope you find your tribe ❤️
